title: Deuxième partie : variations sur l'équation des lacets [suite à La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois…, pages 293 à 650, dont table des matières] : notes et copies de notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting. M is an Azumaya algebra over a base scheme S. From the context it is of rank 4, i.e. a quaternion algebra, so G(M) = M*/G_m is a form of PGL_2. Grothendieck is analysing a moduli scheme X_{ρ,σ}. It parametrises a pair of invertible sections ρ, σ of M (defined up to scalars) whose 'ratio' is unipotent, in the course of solving the 'équation des lacets'. That equation is the relation coming from the genus-0/genus-1 Teichmüller groupoid, where in PSL_2(Z) an elliptic element of order 2, one of order 3, and a parabolic satisfy a product relation.

On the previous page he identifies X_{ρ,σ} with a group scheme B'_0. Here B'_0 sits in the Borel subgroup normalising a unipotent line L_0, centralising ε_0, and lies in an exact sequence 1 → L_0 → B'_0 → … → 1. He also remarks that, by condition (40 bis), the data amount to a unipotent section ε_1 = 1 + N_1 (N_1² = 0) together with ρ, with σ deduced from them.

This page makes that explicit.

1. Formula (77): σ = −ε_1^{-1}ρ = −(1 − N_1)ρ, i.e. σ = −ρ + N_1ρ, i.e. ρ + σ = N_1ρ. An earlier normalising constant λ_0 is dropped, because rescaling ρ and σ by scalars does not change the associated objects F_ρ and F_σ.
2. Condition (42), the invertibility of c = Tr ρ + Tr σ, becomes c = Tr(N_1ρ) ∈ Γ(O_S^*).
3. He assumes 1, ρ, σ are linearly independent in every fibre. This is equivalent to independence of each of the following triples: (1, ρ, N_1ρ); (1, σ, N_1σ); (ρ^{-1}, 1, N_1), by right multiplication by ρ^{-1}; and (σ^{-1}, 1, N_1).
4. He starts a Proposition. Given M, a square-zero section N_1, ε_1 = 1 + N_1, and sections ρ, σ, the following relations (78) are equivalent: ε_1 = −ρσ^{-1}; σ = −ε_1^{-1}ρ; ρ + σ = N_1ρ; ρ + σ = −N_1σ. Any two of ε_1, ρ, σ determine the third, and ρ and N_1 (with N_1² = 0) may be chosen freely.
5. Margin: ρ + σ = N_1ρ = ρN_0 and = −N_1σ = −σN_0, where N_0 = ρ^{-1}N_1ρ (= σ^{-1}N_1σ). Scalars are normalised so that the trace invariant equals 1.

The next page defines ε_0 = int(ρ^{-1})ε_1 = int(σ^{-1})ε_1, the additive one-parameter groups L_0 and L_1, and the Borel subgroup B_0. It then builds the map u ↦ ([u,ρ], [u,σ], det u) to show that X_{ρ,σ} is isomorphic to B'_0. It also normalises to ε_1 = (1 0; 1 1) and Tr N_1ρ = 1 in matrix form.

In short, the page is a normal form / parametrisation of pairs in a twisted PGL_2 whose quotient is unipotent, with nondegeneracy conditions.
errors: No real errors. All the identities check out: σ = −(1−N_1)ρ gives ρ+σ = N_1ρ. Also N_1σ = −N_1ρ + N_1²ρ = −N_1ρ, so ρ+σ = −N_1σ. And σ^{-1}N_1σ = ρ^{-1}(1+N_1)N_1(1−N_1)ρ = ρ^{-1}N_1ρ, so int(ρ^{-1})ε_1 = int(σ^{-1})ε_1 holds as claimed on the next page.

The margin as transcribed ('Tr N_0 = 1' with N_0 = ρ^{-1}N_1ρ) cannot be literally right, since Tr N_0 = Tr N_1 = 0 for a square-zero element. The intended normalisation must be Tr(ρN_0) = Tr(N_1ρ) = 1, which the next page confirms ('on normalise Tr N_1ρ = 1'). This is either a transcription misreading or a slip.
The marginal '(40 bis) devient ε_1 = ρσ' (rather than ρσ^{-1}) only makes sense projectively, under an extra relation such as σ² scalar. That relation is not stated on this page.

ideas.what: Parametrising pairs (ρ,σ) in a form of PGL_2 (Azumaya algebra of rank 4) whose ratio ρσ^{-1} is unipotent, via σ = −(1−N_1)ρ with N_1² = 0.
ideas.modern_name: Character/representation varieties of (triangle or modular) groups into twisted PGL_2; normal forms with a parabolic element
ideas.usually_credited_to: Standard (Fricke–Klein trace coordinates; modern character-variety literature, e.g. Culler–Shalen, Goldman)
ideas.where_published: Unpublished notes, 'variations sur l'équation des lacets' (cote 140-3)

ideas.what: The nondegeneracy condition: 1, ρ, σ linearly independent fibrewise (equivalently 1, ρ^{-1}, N_1), together with invertibility of Tr ρ + Tr σ = Tr N_1ρ.
ideas.modern_name: Irreducibility / non-degeneracy conditions for 2-generator subalgebras of a quaternion algebra

ideas.what: Identifying the moduli scheme X_{ρ,σ} with a subgroup B'_0 of a Borel subgroup, via conjugate unipotents ε_0 = ρ^{-1}ε_1ρ = σ^{-1}ε_1σ.
ideas.modern_name: Torsor / stabiliser description of a moduli of representations

deep.surprise_reason: These are routine, correct algebraic manipulations in a quaternion (Azumaya rank-4) algebra, part of the bookkeeping for a moduli computation in the 'équation des lacets' notes. Nothing here goes beyond standard normal forms for pairs in PGL_2 with a unipotent quotient.
transcription_corrections: The equation label in the Proposition is '(78)' (overwritten), not '(10)'.
'(ρ laisse tomber la constante λ_0' should read '(Je laisse tomber la constante λ_0', i.e. 'J'ai laissé tomber'.
Margin '$\mathrm{Tr}\,N_0 = 1$' should most likely read Tr(ρN_0) = 1, i.e. Tr N_1ρ = 1 (normalisation of c), since Tr N_0 = 0.
'ρ, σ des sections reliées par' is preceded by 'indépendantes': 'ρ, σ des sections inversibles … reliées par (78)'.
'(qui détermine donc chacune des trois sections ε_1, ρ, σ en fonction des deux autres, et on peut se donner arbitrairement ρ et ε_1, i.e. ρ et N_1 de carré nul)'.
